summary: Iteration 19 frontend testing of RPG UI corrections. All 12 features tested. Fixed a bug where Water/Weeds/Fertilize buttons at 100% readyToHarvest didn't trigger 'That won't achieve anything.' thought bubble. Found one remaining size mismatch: BagIconButton (unlocked) is 72x72 while portrait circles are 96x96.

ui_bugs.issue: BagIconButton unlocked state is 72x72 but portrait circles (circleWrap) are 96x96. When bag is unlocked in the garden portrait row, it is visually smaller than player/Rupert circles. The requirement says they should be the same size. LOCKED state uses circleWrap (96x96) matching portraits, but UNLOCKED BagIconButton is 72x72.

action_items: Fix BagIconButton size in PlayerBag.tsx: change bagIconWrap from 72x72 to 96x96 (borderRadius: 48) and bagIconImg from 58x58 to ~80x80 to match portrait circles in garden.tsx
critical_code_review_comments: GardenPlot.tsx: ActionBtn had disabled={disabled} which prevented onPress from firing for harvest-locked buttons. Fixed by separating 'truly disabled' (non-interactive, withered, empty) from 'harvest-locked' (should show bubble). Locked buttons now use locked={true} instead of disabled={true}.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage manipulation to set plot data to 100% (readyToHarvest=true) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test BagIconButton in garden with bag unlocked (@garden:inventory_bag_unlocked=true in localStorage) to verify it matches portrait circle size (should be 96x96). All other features (mainpage.webp, no 'A new day begins.' text, locked bag circle style, scene backgrounds below header, garden plot greyed buttons, thought bubble) are working correctly.
rca_of_issue: GardenPlot ActionBtn bug: waterDisabled/weedsDisabled/fertilizeDisabled were set to true when harvestLocked=true, and ActionBtn used disabled={disabled} which set TouchableOpacity disabled=true, silently swallowing onPress calls. Fix: separated true-disabled from harvest-locked; locked buttons use locked={true} (visual only) while keeping disabled={false} so onPress fires with onLockedAction callback.
